rationale: Post-remediation ContinuityOps is a stronger repo-only reliability lab: worker.zip now byte-matches sources, lab app digest is set and consistent across chart/contract/tar, synthetic restore-verification evidence exists, and STATUS/PLAN/claims no longer overclaim merge_ready. Residual merit gaps—plan-approval still on build-orchestration, evidence SHAs lag HEAD, restore numbers remain synthetic, observability TF thin, teardown evidence pending—keep me from endorsing merge_ready while Stage 2 remediation is openly in progress.
